anomalies.label: SOL–CENTAURI BEARING
anomalies.subtitle: Home System · Twin Golden Reference
anomalies.description: Ten light-years behind you, Sol and Alpha Centauri burn steady in visible light. Step inside to triangulate cluster parallax baselines and prove the horizon curvature points straight back home.

anomalies.label: CARINA RIFT NURSERY
anomalies.subtitle: Dust-Veiled Stellar Cliffs
anomalies.description: Opaque molecular dust hides this stellar nursery in visible light. Sweep into infrared to slice through the dark veil and match spectral absorption lines against an un-redshifted comb behind it.

anomalies.label: CLUSTER J1419-A
anomalies.subtitle: Gravitational Lens & Horizon Seam
anomalies.description: A massive foreground cluster bends ancient starlight into bright arcs. Model the cluster mass and quadrupole shear to pull the lensed galaxies round and expose the rigid geometric seam behind them.

anomalies.label: PULSAR RIFT S-04
anomalies.subtitle: High-Energy Shock & Repeating Facet
anomalies.description: Violent ultraviolet and X-ray jets flare along the survey boundary. Route coherent beams around plasma occluders and equalize the optical delay line to resolve the repeating facet.

anomalies.label: ANTIPODAL POLE SEAM
anomalies.subtitle: 180° Dual-Epoch Horizon Check
anomalies.description: Directly opposite J1419-A across 93 billion light-years, four-month shift plates reveal synchronized geometric shifts faster than light permits.
